question: What theoretical capacity does the paper's definition of 1C correspond to, and what first-discharge capacity does its share of theoretical capacity at 0.1C imply?

trace.query: SELECT id, page, text, strength FROM atoms WHERE text ILIKE '%1C%' OR text ILIKE '%theoretical%' OR text ILIKE '%0.1C%' OR text ILIKE '%mAh%' ORDER BY page, id
SELECT id, text FROM lines WHERE page=5 AND id BETWEEN 'p5.L55' AND 'p5.L70' ORDER BY id
SELECT id, page, text FROM atoms WHERE text ILIKE '%1675%' OR text ILIKE '%1672%' OR text ILIKE '%91%' OR text ILIKE '%theoret%' ORDER BY page, id

SELECT CAST(regexp_extract(l1.text,'C = ([0-9]+)',1) AS DOUBLE) AS one_c_capacity, CAST(regexp_extract(l2.text,'([0-9]+)% of theoretical',1) AS DOUBLE) AS pct, CAST(regexp_extract(l1.text,'C = ([0-9]+)',1) AS DOUBLE) * CAST(regexp_extract(l2.text,'([0-9]+)% of theoretical',1) AS DOUBLE) / 100 AS implied FROM lines l1, lines l2 WHERE l1.id='p5.L62' AND l2.id='p5.L63'
